data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 解发时分
data.description: 【阿尔托莉雅 · 解发时分】卧房内烛光柔和，阿尔托莉雅抬起双手轻轻解开发带，整齐盘起的金色长发如瀑布般披散而下，将修长白皙的后颈展露在你面前。她耳根微红轻声低语——「解开发带的模样……唯独只允许你一人注视。今晚，就请不要移开你的视线。」
data.action: 双手解开盘发的蓝色发带，露出后颈并回头望向镜头
data.lighting: warm candlelight in the royal bedchamber
data.promptProse: Seated in a rear three-quarter view with her hair just released, she looks over her shoulder. The blue ribbon rests at her wrist and Excalibur's scabbard lies across the stool; the opaque mirror reflects only candlelight.
data.identityProseOverride: Artoria Pendragon (Saber) from Fate/stay night, with loose blonde hair, green eyes and an ahoge.
data.animaCaption: The blue ribbon rests at her wrist; the mirror reflects only candlelight.
